name: plate-50-engine-reprint-1c
version_tag: #152 ENGINE REPRINT, SINGLE COLOUR — fixture r63, three sun tower pieces, both carrier arms. Companion to plate-49; split off so the two-colour parts are not hostage to the 34cm3 fixture. 157_fixture_r63 REPLACES 148_fixture_r62: the key now reaches 29.5 and carries the drive post to 26.0, because at 6.5 pitch the old key stopped short and left the top sun pieces free to rotate, which destroys the #134 clocking. Sun tower piece is now 6.50 tall (band 1.5 + slim core 5.0) — PRINT THREE. The 5.0 is taken in the piece itself and NOT as a stack of 0.5mm shims: a 0.5mm shim prints at 2.5 layers, rounds to 0.4 or 0.6, and that z error walks the mesh lamina off its band. Carrier arms carry the #152 stepped bore (4.00 on the 4.20 spigot) and arm 1's riser steps at 19.2 for arm 2; arm 2's riser does NOT step — nothing stacks on the leap post, so it keeps full section. 147_sun_spacer is byte-identical to what is already printed — DO NOT reprint it. 6 objects, flat, no supports, xy-comp -0.06, seam aligned. | QUIET. | +#156 DETENT: 164_detent_star (31 full-pitch V sawtooth ring, pegs into the board's new underside sockets, V-bottom at the datum so REST IS THE STATION) and 163_detent_holder (south of the fixture plate; 1.0mm music wire ~75mm, one 90deg bend, 15mm finger, nose in a V — two-flank point rest, zero backlash; restores any sub-half-step release incl. the 4.63deg July graze; watershed at 5.80 measured off the emitted star). NOTE: board 149 in plate-49 now carries the peg sockets — plates 49 and 50 are a matched set from this commit.
